label: Town of Stratton
header:
# Town of Stratton municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 23; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

Town of Stratton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, town meeting page): Elizabeth Liller was elected Moderator (the minutes' body calls her Beth Liller; her approval signature reads 'Moderator - Elizabeth Liller')
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk

Town of Stratton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, town meeting page): the meeting elected Kent Young Town Clerk to a three-year term; he signs the minutes 'Town Clerk - David Kent Young'
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Kent Young as Stratton's Town Clerk

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names David Young as Stratton's Town Clerk; the full name is David Kent Young per his own signature on the town meeting minutes
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Stratton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, town meeting page): Alyson Peterson was elected Town Treasurer to a three-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Alyson Peterson as Stratton's Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Alyson Peterson as Stratton's Town Treasurer
Town of Stratton official website, Selectboard page: names Albert Dupell (Chair), Larry Bills (Vice Chair), Chris Liller, Greg Marcucci, and Boomer Walker

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Larry Bills, Albert Dupell (Chair), Chris Liller, Greg Marcucci, and Boomer Walker for Stratton's five-member board
Town of Stratton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, town meeting page): Albert Dupell, Greg Marcucci, and Boomer Walker won their seats at the 2026 meeting
Town of Stratton official website, Planning Commission page: names Elizabeth Liller (Chair), Ray Hawksley, Rob Wadsworth, Chris Mann, and George Rigoulot

Town of Stratton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, town meeting page): Stratton elects its planning commissioners from the floor -- Elizabeth Liller and George Rigoulot were elected to three-year terms and Ray Hawksley to a one-year term in 2026
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect three listers on staggered three-year terms
Town of Stratton official website, Assessors page: names Elizabeth Liller (Chair), Britt Wohler, and Candie Bernard as listers
Town of Stratton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, town meeting page): Elizabeth Liller won the 2026 three-year lister seat
Town of Stratton official website, Selectboard page roster: names David Kent Young, Larry Bills, and Chris Liller as Cemetery Commissioners
Town of Stratton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, town meeting page): David Kent Young won the 2026 three-year cemetery commissioner seat

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect trustees of public funds

Town of Stratton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, town meeting page): the meeting elected exactly one Trustee of Public Funds, Alyson Peterson, to a one-year term; Town of Stratton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 4, 2025 (town website, town meeting page) did the same, so the office is single-seat in the town's practice
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a constable
Town of Stratton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, town meeting page): Paul Bernard was elected Constable
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town agent
Town of Stratton, minutes of the annual town meeting of March 3, 2026 (town website, town meeting page): Victor Rivas was elected Town Agent
